document: NDSP Governance Review Ownership and Escalation Register
purpose: Define accountable ownership roles, review responsibilities, escalation levels, response expectations, and closure evidence.

accountability: Own governance policy and final escalation decisions.
Approve policy exceptions and overdue remediation.

escalation_levels.name: GOVERNANCE_REVIEW
escalation_levels.trigger: Overdue review, repeated finding, or missing owner.

escalation_levels.name: RUNTIME_RISK_REVIEW
escalation_levels.trigger: Finding may affect production runtime or exposure.

escalation_levels.name: CRITICAL_ESCALATION
escalation_levels.trigger: Uncontrolled material risk or expired critical evidence.

control_rules: Every governance artifact must have an accountable artifact owner.
Every periodic review must have an assigned review owner.
Missing owners must be escalated to the governance owner.
Overdue actions must advance to the next escalation level.
Critical findings must not wait for the normal review cycle.
Escalation evidence and closure decisions must be retained.
Ownership exceptions must be recorded in PR-012.
Review schedules must remain aligned with PR-013.
Governance-only pull requests must not contain runtime changes.
